local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Knit = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Knit)
Knit.OnStart():andThen(function()
	local states = Knit.GetService("PlayerStateService")
	local function fixture(player)
		local data
		repeat task.wait(0.1); data = states:Get(player) until data or not player.Parent
		if not data then return end
		data.bars = { iron = 23, frost = 2, crystal = 1 }
		data.cash = 12345; data.shards = 17; data.rebirths = 2
		states:ReplicateNow(player)
		print("HUD_QA: mixed carried bars replicated")
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) task.spawn(fixture, player) end)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do task.spawn(fixture, player) end
end)
